# openai_workload_identity_federation_rule (Resource)

Bind verified workload token attributes to an existing project service account. Uses the configured OpenAI admin key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_workload_identity_provider" "github" {
  name     = "GitHub Actions"
  issuer   = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  audience = "openai"
}

resource "openai_project" "example" {
  name = "Example"
}

resource "openai_project_service_account" "ci" {
  project_id = openai_project.example.id
  name       = "ci"
}

resource "openai_workload_identity_federation_rule" "ci" {
  workload_identity_provider_id = openai_workload_identity_provider.github.id
  project_id                    = openai_project.example.id
  service_account_id            = openai_project_service_account.ci.id
  name                          = "Release workflow"

  attribute_matchers = jsonencode({
    sub = "repo:example/repository:ref:refs/heads/main"
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_matchers` (String) JSON object matching verified attributes to string, boolean or number values. Use jsonencode to preserve value types.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project containing the service account.
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the service account to authenticate as.
- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) ID of the workload identity provider.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `permissions` (Attributes) Token permissions. Defaults to the service account's permissions on creation. Omitting this object later preserves the existing configuration; set type = service_account_default explicitly to restore default permissions. Use restricted with non-empty scopes to narrow access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource ID.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `type` (String) Permission mode: service_account_default or restricted.

Optional:

- `scopes` (Set of String) Non-empty set of scopes. Required only for restricted permissions.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openai_workload_identity_federation_rule.ci wip_example/wifr_example
```
